items.html: And its judgment was not revealed in its full force there, in the high place, until it was revealed in the thirteen corrections of the beard, which are the hairs, all of which are judgments, as is known. And as we shall write below, in the explanation of what is said in Idra Rabba, page 132, side A, and page 135, side A, concerning those three worlds that issue from that first correction of the beard. Therefore they said in Idra Rabba, page 131, side B: "The Tanna said, all the hairs, whether of the beard or of the head, are all white as snow. And the Tanna said, those of the beard are hard, all of them like fists." See there.
